description: Businesses are increasingly hiring freelancers who can produce faceless YouTube videos and handle editing. Fiverr’s Business Trends Index reported major growth in searches for ‘faceless YouTube video creator’ (+488%) and ‘faceless YouTube video editor’ (+59%), highlighting high demand for video creators who can script, edit and animate while maintaining anonymity【842426528165656†L61-L64】.

AI automation freelancers design and implement automated workflows for businesses, using AI tools to streamline tasks. Searches on Fiverr for ‘AI automation’ grew by 136% in the 2025 Business Trends Index, reflecting increased client demand for automated solutions【842426528165656†L61-L64】.

Clients need experts to craft effective prompts for generative AI models. Fiverr reported a 76% spike in searches for ‘prompt engineering,’ indicating strong demand for freelancers who can design and optimize prompts for marketing, research and content creation【842426528165656†L61-L64】.

Freelancers build conversational chatbots for customer service, lead‑qualification and support using frameworks such as OpenAI, LangChain, Rasa and Dialogflow. Businesses often lack the skills to customize and integrate bots; freelancers handle discovery questions, persona design, fallback logic and multi‑channel integration. Fiverr lists hundreds of chatbot development gigs and an ‘AI Agents’ subcategory【534614721102563†L40-L69】.

Generative AI can produce custom illustrations (e.g., book covers and character art) quickly. Freelancers differentiate themselves by curating and refining outputs—adjusting styles, removing artifacts, layering and vectorizing images. On Fiverr, AI‑generated services and AI artist categories attract significant traffic【534614721102563†L77-L97】.

Businesses are moving beyond off‑the‑shelf models and require AI tailored to their brand or domain. Freelancers fine‑tune models such as LLaMA, GPT or Stable Diffusion with client data, build API wrappers, and deploy models. Fiverr’s ‘Generative AI Models’ subcategory offers services from model creation to optimization, highlighting this growing niche【534614721102563†L101-L124】.

AI becomes a drafting engine while the freelancer provides the human voice. Services include GPT‑powered blog posts, web copy, product descriptions, content augmentation, SEO prompt engineering, and repurposing content into social posts and emails. Freelancers who master the AI + human workflow are in demand【534614721102563†L130-L149】.

gig: AI audio & voice synthesis / podcast production
description: Freelancers use AI voice models (e.g., ElevenLabs, Resemble, Replica) to generate custom voiceovers for commercials, explainer videos, audiobooks and podcasts. They often bundle voice generation with editing, mastering, noise removal and sound design. This niche remains less saturated and allows freelancers to deliver studio‑level quality【534614721102563†L155-L176】.

Many clients have access to powerful AI models but lack prompt expertise. Freelancers design prompt libraries for marketing, sales and research, build automated workflows and tool‑chaining pipelines, perform prompt audits and provide training. Subscription‑based AI consulting is a growing business model【534614721102563†L177-L196】.

Brands increasingly hire freelancers to create AI‑driven influencer content and manage platform‑specific campaigns. Fiverr’s Business Trends Index showed rising searches for TikTok promotion (+66%), social media managers (+33%), Instagram reels (+24%) and TikTok editors (+14%), reflecting the need for short‑form, high‑impact content and platform fluency【842426528165656†L83-L91】.

Demand for AI video creators surged as businesses sought cinematic storytelling. Searches for ‘AI video creators’ increased by 66% and for ‘AI music video’ by 25%, showing strong interest in professionals who can harness AI to produce high‑quality video content【842426528165656†L61-L64】.
